chapters.title: Interleave copies, then split
chapters.code:
def copy_random_list(head):
    node = head
    while node:                                # 1. A -> A' -> B -> B'
        node.next = Node(node.val, node.next)
        node = node.next.next
    node = head
    while node:                                # 2. copy of X is X.next
        if node.random:
            node.next.random = node.random.next
        node = node.next.next
    dummy = tail = Node(0)
    node = head
    while node:                                # 3. unweave, restoring the original
        c = node.next
        node.next = c.next
        tail.next = tail = c
        node = node.next
    return dummy.next
